titles.title: 438 - You Will See Your Lord A-Coming
You Will See Your Lord A-Coming

properties.verseOrder: v1 c1 v2 v3 v4 v5

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
You will see your Lord acoming,
You will see your Lord acoming,
You will see your Lord acoming
In a few more days.
Hear the band of music,
Hear the band of music,
Hear the band of music
which is sounding thro’ the air.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Hear the band of music,
Hear the band of music,
Hear the band of music
which is sounding thro' the air.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Gabriel sounds his mighty trumpet,
Gabriel sounds his mighty trumpet,
Gabriel sounds his mighty trumpet
In a few more days.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
You will see the saints arising,
You will see the saints arising,
You will see the saints arising
In a few more days.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Angels bear them to the Savior,
Angels bear them to the Savior,
Angels bear them to the Savior
In a few more days.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Then we'll shout, our suff'ring over, Then we'll shout, our suff'ring over, Then we'll shout, our suff'ring over In a few more days.
